title: [WT-19b] Test: pre-flip worktree dry run on a branch target (parallel landings, conflict resume, candidate gate)
definitionOfDone: scripts/tests/worktree-e2e.cjs is the only changed file. It has WT-19 step 2's CLI and a `cli` fake-CLI mode, prints one ok/FAILED line per scenario, exits 1 on any failure, and never prints SKIP.

Parallel: with consolidationBranch set to a slash-named non-main target, two seats launched at once land task-a and task-b. The target gains exactly two commits, `git log --first-parent <target>` is linear, every refs/heads/<target> reflog entry is a fast-forward, the local target equals the bare origin's, main never moves, and neither worktree holds .moe.

Conflict-resume: task-c's first attempt ends unlanded (the target does not move; finalize_attempt records outcome 'unlanded'). Its second session gets the LANDING-CONFLICT prompt, resolves it and lands on the target. History stays linear and fast-forward only, and main never moves.

Control follows: after every landing, moe/control's HEAD equals the target and `git status` is clean, MOE_CONTROL_ADVANCED is printed, and none of MOE_CONTROL_NOT_FOLLOWING, MOE_CONTROL_CHECKOUT_BEHIND or MOE_CONTROL_CHECKOUT_DIVERGED appears.

Gate: every landing runs `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && npm run lint` in the wrapper's gate workspace and prints the wrapper's gate-pass line. The gate string is prefixed with a probe proving the workspace holds no .moe/.

The verification command exits 0 with <parent-tmp> under /mnt/d/moe-scratch, run from a HEAD snapshot that contains WT-13's landing. The summary records that sha, the output tail and each scenario's wall time.
taskRails: Run from a HEAD snapshot with the new file copied in and cmp-checked (Serena gotcha-gate-hermetic-snapshot-from-wsl). This keeps in-flight lane edits (31187ec1, WT-10M) out.
Handle any missing fake-proxy behaviour inside the new file.
A wrapper defect becomes a bug: row in this epic, with the output. Never weaken an assertion.

implementationPlan.description:
Create scripts/tests/worktree-e2e.cjs with its two helper modes, both checked before any argv parsing.

The shared fake proxy is single-seat at HEAD 204cacb8 (planner research), and this row may not edit it (task rails):
- task id is always 'task-postflight' (:448);
- attempt is always 'attempt-postflight' with generation 7 (:71);
- .moe/context-count is project-wide;
- the lease grants everyone (:285);
- finalize_attempt refuses 'unlanded' (:141).
Re-read the landed fake after WT-11/WT-12/WT-13 before relying on any of these; their tests may have added knobs.

(1) `cli` mode, the fake CLI (`node worktree-e2e.cjs cli …`). Model it on postflight-worktree.cjs :22-36.
- `--version` prints a fake version.
- Write one JSON record to $E2E_CLI_RECORD: cwd, argv, the prompt/context the wrapper passed, MERGE_HEAD present in cwd (`git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD`), and conflict markers per path listed in $E2E_CLI_EXPECT_MARKERS.
- Then apply $E2E_CLI_WRITE ({relpath: content}) under cwd.
- Exit 0. Run no git write.
- Launch it through a forwarding `claude` type shim (postflight-worktree.cjs typeShim :161), never cliShim. cliShim drops argv, which leaves the prompt empty (mem:gotcha-postflight-worktree-clishim-drops-argv).

(2) Seat interposer: proxy mode, active when $E2E_SEAT_STATE is set. MOE_PROXY_PATH points at this file, and the wrapper runs `node $MOE_PROXY_PATH` with the request on stdin.
- Land-lease tools (acquire_resource, wait_for_resource, release_resource): handled here with an EXCLUSIVE, task-keyed lock file under the e2e root, created with O_EXCL.
  - Reply shapes exactly as HEAD's acquire_land_lease/land_lease_read/release_land_lease parse them.
  - wait polls until granted or timeoutMs runs out.
  - Log each hold interval.
- Every other tool: in the raw request text, translate the seat's ids to the fake's ('task-<s>' to 'task-postflight', 'attempt-<s><n>' to 'attempt-postflight').
  - Spawn `node $E2E_FAKE` with MOE_PROJECT_PATH=<seat state dir> and GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=<e2e root>, so each seat's fake state is private.
  - Reverse-translate the reply.
  - Then mirror the seat's fake attempt record, with ids translated, to <control>/.moe/attempts/attempt-<s><n>.json via tmp+rename. The wrapper reads attempts there (moe_attempt_read: exactly one open attempt per task).
- record_check_run: re-apply the fake's 'CheckRun must persist before CAS' check against the CONTROL repo. The fake skips it because a state dir is not a repo. On mismatch, fail the call as the fake fails an assertion.
- If the landed fake still refuses finalize_attempt 'unlanded' or serves no landingRetry, implement them here as WT-03 does (docs/MCP_SERVER.md moe.finalize_attempt):
  - validate the call;
  - close the attempt;
  - store {reason, paths, rescueRef, targetTip, count, at};
  - reply with taskStatus and landingRetry;
  - inject task.landingRetry into that seat's get_context.
- Append {session, tool, args, reply or error, start, end}, in the seat's own ids, to <seat dir>/rpcs.jsonl.

Error handling: a malformed request, a fake that exits non-zero, or a translation that cannot apply fails the call with its reason; nothing is ever answered 'success' blindly. Never embed the fake's request-parsing line (parity-check guards it; mem:gotcha-parity-check-fake-proxy-derived-copies).
implementationPlan.note: Wrote the new scripts/tests/worktree-e2e.cjs (373 lines, test-only, no existing file edited, fake marker line not embedded). Step 1 covers its two helper modes. (1) `cli` is the fake CLI: per launch it records cwd, argv, the prompt or its context file, MERGE_HEAD and conflict markers in W at start, then writes E2E_CLI_WRITE under W and makes no git write. (2) The E2E_SEAT_STATE interposer is the seat's MOE_PROXY_PATH. It translates task-<s>/attempt-<s><n> to the fake's fixed ids and back (boundary regex), and runs each seat's fake in a private state dir. It owns the land lease as a capacity-1 O_EXCL lock file under the e2e root (the fake grants everyone), logging grants and releases to lease.jsonl. It re-runs the CheckRun-before-CAS check against the control repo, mirrors the seat's attempt into <control>/.moe/attempts (moe_attempt_read) before each reply, and logs every RPC to <seat>/rpcs.jsonl. The fake's 'unlanded' and task.landingRetry are handled only while the fake lacks them (static probe). WT-11's in-flight fake edit is uncommitted, so the resume session re-reads the landed fake per the governor ruling and drops this fallback if the fake covers it. A direct probe against a /tmp snapshot found: 'unlanded' closes and stores, the ids round-trip, a bad reason or foreign rescueRef is refused, and get_context serves landingRetry. Other sessions' dirty paths (postflight-fake-proxy.js, postflight-worktree.cjs, .moe/roles, skills) are untouched.

implementationPlan.description:
worktree-e2e.cjs main CLI: `<sh|ps1> <wrapper> <fake-proxy> <parent-tmp> <engine>` (WT-19 step 2).
- `ps1` exits 2 with a clear message: the ps1 leg is WT-19's. Never print a line starting with SKIP.
- Resolve paths absolutely. Root = mkdtemp(<parent-tmp>/wt-e2e-), with no space.
- Print the wrapper checkout's `git rev-parse HEAD` first.

Fixture, built once:
(a) Bare origin.git.
(b) control = `git init -b main`.
- Commit 1's tree is EXACTLY the wrapper checkout's HEAD^{tree}, for example via `git fetch -q --depth=1 file://<root> HEAD` plus read-tree or commit-tree. Assert the tree equality.
- Set repo-local user Moe Test / moe@test.local and core.autocrlf=false.
(c) Commit 2 on main:
- .moe/project.json with settings {worktreeMode:'on', consolidationBranch:'moe/work-e2e', autoCommit:true, qualityGate: GATE};
- e2e/shared.txt with 10 numbered lines.
(d) Branches and remote:
- `git branch moe/work-e2e main`;
- `git branch moe/task/task-c moe/work-e2e`, so task-c's W is cut before task-a lands;
- `git switch -c moe/control moe/work-e2e`;
- remote origin with main and moe/work-e2e pushed.
Do NOT pre-set extensions.worktreeConfig: task-c7ca56e6 fixes that race, and pre-setting it would hide it.
(e) Per seat s in a, b, c: a state dir holding .moe/project.json plus tasks/task-postflight.json, shaped like postflight-worktree.cjs repo() :91.

GATE = `test ! -e .moe && test ! -L .moe && printf '%s\n' "$PWD" >> '<root>/gate-runs.log' && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && npm run lint`.

launch(seat, session, opts) spawns `<engine> <wrapper> --project <control> --worker-id worker-e2e-<s> --role worker --team E2E --no-start-daemon --command <claude shim> --no-loop --poll-interval 0`, detached.
- Env: postflight-worktree.cjs inherited() :45, which strips MOE_/FAKE_/WT_/CLAUDE*/GIT_*, also strips E2E_, then adds:
  - MOE_PROXY_PATH=this file, MOE_NODE_COMMAND, MOE_DISABLE_HEARTBEAT=1, MOE_ACCOUNT_ROTATION=off;
  - a per-seat HOME and TMPDIR (seats share ~/.config writes otherwise);
  - FAKE_TASK_STATUS=REVIEW;
  - FAKE_CLAIM_WORKSPACE and FAKE_CTX_WORKSPACE = {mode:'worktree', path:<control>/.worktrees/task-<s>, branch:'moe/task/task-<s>', target:'moe/work-e2e'};
  - E2E_* for the interposer and the CLI.
- Timeout: MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC, default 900. Kill only the process group of the wrapper this file spawned, by recorded PID (GLOBAL rail; killTree :195). Save each session's VT-stripped log.

Reporting:
- `[worktree-e2e] <scenario> ok (<secs> s)`, or `… FAILED: <reason>` followed by `  | ` tails of the failing session logs.
- Then `[worktree-e2e] N ok, M failed`; exit 1 on any failure.

Cleanup: remove only the root under <parent-tmp>, on every exit path including SIGINT/SIGTERM. MOE_KEEP_E2E_FIXTURE=1 keeps it and prints the path.

Error handling: a fixture command that fails throws its stderr into that scenario's FAILED line; it never passes vacuously.
implementationPlan.note: Main CLI `<sh|ps1> <wrapper> <fake-proxy> <parent-tmp> <engine>`. ps1 exits 2 and names WT-19 (task-b1ca54f2); a usage error exits 2; nothing prints SKIP. The fixture is built once under mkdtemp(<parent>/wt-e2e-), with a whitespace root refused as a FAILED line. It prints the wrapper checkout's HEAD. Commit 1 is commit-tree of a depth-1 fetch, asserted equal to HEAD^{tree}; commit 2 is the e2e settings plus e2e/shared.txt. It then creates moe/work-e2e, cuts moe/task/task-c before any landing, switches to moe/control, and pushes main and the target to a bare origin. extensions.worktreeConfig=true is set after (d), before any seat, and asserted to read back (governor ruling: task-c7ca56e6 lands after the switch). Per-seat state dirs, HOME and TMPDIR live under the root. GATE is the .moe-probe-prefixed parity-check plus lint, appending $PWD to gate-runs.log. launch() spawns the real wrapper detached through a forwarding claude shim; env is inherited() minus E2E_ plus the interposer, the workspace JSON and E2E_*; a MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 900) timer kills only that recorded process group; the log is VT-stripped and saved. Output is one ok/FAILED line per scenario with `  | ` log tails, then the N ok / M failed total and exit 1 on any failure. Cleanup removes only the root, also on SIGINT/SIGTERM; MOE_KEEP_E2E_FIXTURE=1 keeps it. Deviation, with bug row task-b6a3d41e (WORKER, BACKLOG): the fixture pre-seeds <control>/.claude/agents, which is the live checkout's ignored state. Without it, two moe-agent.sh seats starting at once race the subagent mirror (`cp: ... File exists` under set -e killed seat b in pre-flight in trial 1). No assertion is weakened.

implementationPlan.description:
Scenario (a) `parallel`, plus the per-landing checks both scenarios reuse.

Launch seats a and b at once (spawn both, then await both). CLI writes:
- a: e2e/a.txt, plus shared.txt line 2 changed to `line 2: task-a`;
- b: e2e/b.txt, plus shared.txt line 8 changed to `line 8: task-b`.
These are non-adjacent hunks of ONE file, which proves same-file parallel landing.

Assert:
- Both exit 0. No report_blocked appears in either seat's rpcs.jsonl. Each log shows `[worktree] created <control>/.worktrees/task-<s> on moe/task/task-<s>`.
- The target gained exactly 2 commits (`rev-list --count` from the fixture tip), with no merges (`rev-list --merges` empty), so `git log --first-parent moe/work-e2e` is linear.
- Every `git log -g --format=%H refs/heads/moe/work-e2e` entry descends from the one before it (fast-forward only).
- `git -C origin.git rev-parse refs/heads/moe/work-e2e` equals the local target.
- main is unchanged, locally and in origin.
- The target tree holds a.txt, b.txt and both shared.txt edits.
- Each seat recorded finalize_attempt 'landed' with landedRevision equal to one of the two new commits, plus a committed completion record_commit.
- Neither W has .moe (no file, dir or link).
- The interposer's two lease hold intervals are disjoint: the gated landings serialized.

afterLanding(sessionLogs), run after every landing session:
- control: `symbolic-ref HEAD` == refs/heads/moe/control, HEAD == the target tip, `git status --porcelain` empty;
- MOE_CONTROL_ADVANCED in each landing session's log;
- none of MOE_CONTROL_NOT_FOLLOWING, MOE_CONTROL_CHECKOUT_BEHIND or MOE_CONTROL_CHECKOUT_DIVERGED in ANY log;
- `[OK] qualityGate passed.` at least once per landing session;
- gate-runs.log gained one line per gate run, each a directory that is neither the control nor any W (the wrapper's gate workspace).
Spell codes as HEAD's landed WT-13 wrappers do (grep them first). If a spelling differs from this plan, the code wins; note it in the summary.

Any failure here that is a wrapper defect becomes a `bug:` row in this epic with the session log (task rail). Never weaken an assertion.

amendments.description:
Verification. Run ONCE, fresh, from the repo root, as ONE command: `<checkRefs[0]> && <checkRefs[1]>`, exactly as in the executionContract.
- [0] requires WT-13's completion in HEAD, prints the snapshot sha, makes a `git clone --shared` snapshot at HEAD, and copies the new file in with cmp (task rail; mem:gotcha-gate-hermetic-snapshot-from-wsl).
- [1] runs the e2e from that snapshot with <parent-tmp> under /mnt/d/moe-scratch.
The governor resumes this row only once HEAD holds both WT-11's (task-dd1ee586b90d4fc785434454b1423e76) and WT-13's (task-fbe8e3880ddf47dfa8546f220acea770) completion commits (comment-56b2a0e5), so HEAD always carries WT-11. Check for WT-11's `Moe-Task: task-dd1ee586b90d4fc785434454b1423e76` + `Moe-Kind: completion` trailer before trusting any c1/c2 failure.

The run can take longer than one 10-minute tool call (drvfs checkouts of about 976 files per worktree and per gate workspace). In that case run the joined command under nohup with a log and an .exit file, and poll it in the foreground until it finishes (mem:gotcha-daemon-linux-snapshot-gate polling recipe). Never leave it running in the background past your turn.

The summary records:
- the snapshot sha;
- each scenario's wall time;
- the output tail.

If HEAD's wrapper bytes carry a wip checkpoint of a still-open lane row (31187ec1, WT-10M or WT-14) and the run fails because of it:
- re-run at the newest commit that contains BOTH WT-11's and WT-13's completion trailers but not that wip. task-c7ca56e6 lands after the switch, so no usable snapshot contains it (mem:gotcha-snapshot-gate-peer-wip-checkpoint).
- If no such commit exists, do NOT verify on a snapshot without WT-11. Call moe.report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds [] and a reason naming the wip sha and the failing c1/c2 output, then post the same in #governors. Never name the wip's row as the blocker: 31187ec1, WT-10M and WT-14 all wait on the switch gate, which waits on this row, so the daemon drops that id as a cycle.
- disclose it;
- never edit a wrapper.

implementationPlan.note:
Negative controls ran on mutant copies in /tmp/wt19b (outside the repo; no tracked wrapper edited), with an ext4 parent, against snapshot wrappers 072dd78c/754dfb35, whose scripts are identical. They were run before and after the fix below, with the same results both times:
(i) GATE prefixed `mkdir .moe &&`: parallel FAILED "the target gained 0 commits, expected 2". The wrapper printed `qualityGate failed (exit 1)` and MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE, and rescued both seats.
(ii) c2 CLI writes nothing, so the markers stay: conflict-resume FAILED "c2: the marker scan refused a clean resolution", with MOE_WORKTREE_UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT and no landing.
(iii) the control switched to e2e-off before (a): parallel FAILED "a1: exit code 1", with `[ERROR] MOE_CONTROL_NOT_FOLLOWING` and no landing.
Every fixture root was removed.

Self-review found one real defect, in THIS file (not a wrapper). It surfaced in fresh run 2 (snapshot 754dfb35): parallel FAILED "the target gained 1 commits, expected 2", because b1 got MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_LAND_LEASE, "wait_for_resource ... refused, cancelled, unanswered or malformed".
- Cause: the interposer's lease holder() did a check-then-read (lstat, then readFileSync). Seat a's release unlinked the lock in between, so ENOENT came back as an error reply.
- RED, a two-seat lease stress probe on drvfs (/tmp/wt19b/lease-probe.cjs, 300 calls): 10 ENOENT errors.
- Fix: holder() treats ENOENT as no holder and retries a half-written lock; take() answers "not granted" when the lock changed hands on all 3 tries.
- GREEN: 0 errors, 267 grants, 0 overlapping holds.
- Three unmutated runs on ext4 then all passed: 2 ok each.
Checklist results:
- Concurrency: the O_EXCL lock plus the race fix; the attempt mirror is written tmp+rename.
- No vacuous pass: every list is length-checked (rpcs, holds, gate lines, reflog > 1).
- Hermetic env: MOE_/CLAUDE/E2E_/FAKE_/GIT_ dir vars are stripped. GIT_CONFIG_* passes through, the same as postflight-worktree.cjs; it is the session's includeIf overlay for the live checkout only.
- Cleanup: only the root is removed, and only recorded wrapper process groups are killed.
- No SKIP; the fake's request-parsing line is not embedded; parity-check PASS in place.
The file is 350 lines (under 400). Final fresh run 3: exit 0 (see complete_task).

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- Editing postflight-fake-proxy.js to add per-seat ids: forbidden. This row edits no existing file, and the rail says 'handle any missing fake-proxy behaviour inside the new file'. The plan uses a per-seat interposer that delegates every tool to the shared fake in a private state dir, with id translation.
- A private full fake inside the new file: rejected. It would duplicate about 750 lines and drift, and the description requires the shared fake.
- Delegating the land lease per seat: rejected. Per-seat fakes grant every caller, so two gated landings would gate the same B. The interposer's O_EXCL lock models the daemon's capacity-1 lease.
- Running a WORKING checkpoint session first to give task-c an older base: replaced by `git branch moe/task/task-c` at the fixture tip. The DoD's 'first attempt ends unlanded' then means the first session.
- Pre-setting extensions.worktreeConfig: rejected, because it hides a real race. Filed as task-c7ca56e6 and added as a dependency.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- postflight-worktree.cjs is CLI-only (no exports), so its helpers are copied, not required.
- Its launch() wipes project-wide logs and uses one worker id.
- The wrapper runs the proxy per RPC with MOE_PROJECT_PATH=<control>, reads attempt records directly from <control>/.moe/attempts, and derives W from the claim's task id.
- The fake's CheckRun check uses git on MOE_PROJECT_PATH and is skipped outside a repo, so the interposer re-checks it against the control.
- The target is read from settings.consolidationBranch; the workspace mode comes from the claim/context workspace knobs.
planningNotes.risks:
- WT-11/WT-12/WT-13 may land different spellings or fake knobs than their plans say. Read the landed code first; the code wins.
- drvfs makes each worktree or gate checkout slow (about 976 files). Use a 1200 s per-run timeout, and nohup plus a foreground poll past the 10-min tool limit.
- Two seats' L13 control follows can race on the one control checkout. If that surfaces BEHIND or a lock error, it is a wrapper bug: file it, do not soften the test.
- Shared HOME writes (mcp_servers.json) are avoided with a per-seat HOME.
- The lease reply shape must match land_lease_read exactly (granted:true plus lease.taskId plus acquiredAt).
- The test file may exceed 400 net lines; keep it dense and say so in the summary.
- Never kill by pattern; kill only spawned process groups.
